title: Grammar: Hypotheticals and Subjunctive
description: Practice the imperfect for hypothetical situations and subjunctive clauses.

sentences.french: Si j'étais riche, je voyagerais partout dans le monde.
sentences.english: If I were rich, I would travel all over the world.

sentences.french: J'aimerais qu'ils viennent à la fête.
sentences.english: I would like them to come to the party.

sentences.french: Le professeur a demandé que nous fassions nos devoirs.
sentences.english: The teacher asked us to do the homework.

sentences.french: Si j'avais plus de temps, j'apprendrais une autre langue.
sentences.english: If I had more time, I would learn another language.

sentences.french: C'était dommage que tu ne puisses pas assister au mariage.
sentences.english: It was a shame that you couldn't attend the wedding.

sentences.french: Je cherchais une voiture qui ne coûte pas si cher.
sentences.english: I was looking for a car that didn't cost so much money.

sentences.french: Si tu savais la vérité, tu ne serais pas si calme.
sentences.english: If you knew the truth, you wouldn't be so calm.

sentences.french: Je doutais qu'elle soit sérieuse à propos du déménagement.
sentences.english: I doubted that she was serious about moving.

sentences.french: J'ai suggéré que nous allions nous promener dans le parc.
sentences.english: I suggested that we go out for a walk in the park.

sentences.french: Si seulement il pleuvait du café dans la campagne.
sentences.english: I wish it would rain coffee in the countryside.

voiture.mnemonic: No easy English cognate, but essential for travel.

cher.mnemonic: You hold things 'dear' when they cost a lot.
